snippet.title: Left 4 Dead 2 - The Last Stand Update [Official Teaser #1]
snippet.description:
It has been many years since the infection first hit. Radio silence, no sign of life, nothing but lingering hopes... CEDA is not going to save us.
But there is hope! A few brave souls have continued the fight against all odds, and soon we can all benefit from their resilience.
"The Last Stand" is an update for Left 4 Dead 2, created by the community, for the community. Additional details will be coming soon.

Left 4 Dead 1 & 2 are property of Valve Corporation, all rights reserved.

Check out the official Valve announcement on the L4D Blog and Steam here:
https://www.l4d.com/blog/post.php?id=64861
